The padded masked language model used in our experiments uses the uncased BERT-base architecture (Devlin et al., 2019) with 110M parameters. It is pretrained with the maximum pad length of $n_p = 4$ on the Wikipedia and books corpora that the original BERT was also trained on. When creating MLM finetuning data for the source and the target domain, we always mask out only a single span of zero to four input tokens so that the masked span corresponds to whole word(s).
